caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned object resembling a candlestick holder or vase made of glass or a similar material. The object is rendered in shades of purple, with darker and lighter tones used to suggest depth, curvature, and reflective surfaces. The structure consists of a wide, flat, circular top which narrows into a vertically elongated stem. The stem features a series of vertical, oval-shaped raised details and grooves, contributing to a decorative appearance. The base is broad and has a polygonal, faceted design, providing stability to the object. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige with no additional elements, patterns, or shading. The lower right corner of the drawing contains the name "JANET RIZA" printed in capital letters.
title: Vase
